name: Wallop

effects.description: Active: Gnar slams his arm down in the target direction, dealing physical damage to all enemies struck within the area and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

notes:
Gnar is locked out of moving and casting movement abilities for 0.25 seconds after the cast time.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
